meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查网页和界面的显示效果，输出截图与结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常调整界面，想快速确认外观没有变坏。
copy.tagline_en: Inspect web, terminal, or paginated UI and get a screenshot-based verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you update UIs often and want to double-check appearances before sharing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会对网页、终端或分页文档等界面做视觉质检：先截图并与参考图比对生成差异数据，再派两个独立审查代理分别检查设计规范与视觉缺陷，最后给出“通过”或“需修改”的结论。
howto.when: 当你构建或改动任何界面（网页、终端界面、分页文档等），或询问某个页面/组件是否显示正确时，会触发它进行视觉检查。

say.text: 我刚改完登录页，帮我做一轮视觉检查。
say.note: 它会截图并比对参考，再给出结论。

say.text: 这个页面看起来对吗？帮我验证一下。
say.note: 它会按技能流程检查并回复结果。

say.text: 帮我检查终端界面有没有文字溢出或边框错位。
say.note: 它会用真实终端渲染并检查宽度与对齐。

howto.what_en: Claude performs visual QA on UI builds/changes: captures screenshots, diffs against references, dispatches two read-only reviewer agents (design-system + visual defects), and returns a PASS/REVISE/FAIL verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you build or change any UI (web page, terminal/TUI, paginated document), or ask whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

say_en.text: I just changed the login page. Run a visual check.
say_en.note: It captures screenshots and reports a verdict.

say_en.text: Does this page look right? Please verify it.
say_en.note: It runs the full QA flow and replies with pass/fail.

say_en.text: Check this terminal UI for overflow or misaligned borders.
say_en.note: It renders in a real pty and inspects layout.
